versions.content: Large Data Path TP Transmission Previous identifiers: SWS_LdCom_00063 When Com_CopyTxData and Com_TpTxConfirmation are invoked for an I-PDU with ComIPduLargeData set to true, AUTOSAR COM module shall use the passed I-PDU ID as Handle Id ( ComIPduHandleId ) to derive the corresponding <ComUser_- ComCbkCopyTxData> or <ComUser_ComCbkTpTxConfirmation> user notification callback and call it with the according Com user callback handle Id.
